G1342.strongs: equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively)
senses: of persons, observant of δίκη, custom, rule, right, righteous in performing duties to gods and men;
of things, righteous, in accordance with right. In NT
righteous, chiefly in the broad sense, as above, of the person or thing corresponding to the Divine standard of right

of things: ἔργα δ., opposite to πονηρὰ, [[r:1JN.3.12|1Jn 3:12]]; ἐντολή, [[r:ROM.7.12|Rom 7:12]]; metaphorically, αἷμα, [[r:MAT.23.35|Mat 23:35]]; τὸ δ., [[r:LUK.12.57|Luk 12:57]]; δ. ἐστιν, [[r:ACT.4.19|Act 4:19]], [[r:EPH.6.1|Eph 6:1]], [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7]]; ὅ, [[r:MAT.20.4|Mat 20:4]]; ὅσα, [[r:PHP.4.8|Php 4:8]]
of persons, as in later cl. writers, just, rendering to each his due: [[r:TIT.1.8|Tit 1:8]], [[r:1JN.1.9|1Jn 1:9]]; δ. κριτής, [[r:2TI.4.8|2Ti 4:8]]

of things: τὸ δ., [[r:COL.4.1|Col 4:1]]; δ., sc. ἐστιν, [[r:2TH.1.6|2Th 1:6]]; κρίσις δ., [[r:JHN.5.30|Jhn 5:30]]; ὁδοί, [[r:REV.15.3|Rev 15:3]] SYN.: ἀγαθός (which see), καλός, χρηστός (Cremer, 183, 690). (AS)
two years old: ἀπὸ δ. (sc. παιδός, or neuter; cf. [[r:1CH.27.23|1Ch 27:23]], ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς), [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16.]]† (AS)

G1380.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb, δόκω (used only in an alternate in certain tenses
G1380.strongs: compare the base of) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly)
G1380.kjv: be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow
senses: (δόκος, opinion, δέκομαι, Ion, form of δέχ-),

to seem, be reputed: [[r:ACT.25.27|Act 25:27]]; with inf., [[r:MRK.10.42|Mrk 10:42]], [[r:LUK.10.36|Luk 10:36 22:24]], [[r:ACT.17.13|Act 17:13 26:9]], [[r:1CO.11.16|1Co 11:16 12:22]], [[r:2CO.10.9|2Co 10:9]], [[r:GAL.2.6|Gal 2:6]], 9, [[r:HEB.4.1|Heb 4:1 12:11]]; οἱ δοκοῦντες, those of repute, [[r:GAL.2.2|Gal 2:2.]] Impers., it seems, with dative of person(s);

to please, seem good to: with inf., [[r:LUK.1.3|Luk 1:3]], [[r:ACT.15.22|Act 15:22, 25 15:23, 34]].† SYN. (δοκέω 1): ἡγέομαι 2, νομίζω2, οἴομαι; ἡ. and ν. properly express belief resting on external proof, ἡ. denoting the more careful judgment; δ. and οἴ. imply a subjective judgment which in the case of οἴ. is based on feeling, in δ. on thought (see Schmidt, with 17) (δοκέω2): φαίνομαι; φ., from the standpoint of the object, "expresses how a matter phenomenally shows and presents itself"; δ., from the standpoint of the observer, expresses one's subjective judgment about a matter (see Tr., Syn., LXXx; Cremer, 204). (AS)

G1343.strongs: equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification
senses: (δίκαιος), the character of ὁ δίκαιος (which see)

in broad sense, righteousness, conformity to the Divine will in purpose, thought and action: [[r:MAT.5.6|Mat 5:6]], [[r:JHN.16.8|Jhn 16:8]], [[r:ACT.13.10|Act 13:10]], [[r:ROM.4.3|Rom 4:3]]; λόγος δικαιοσύνης, teaching of r., [[r:HEB.5.13|Heb 5:13]]; βασιλεὺς δ. (cf. FlJ, BJ, vi, 10, β. δίκαιος), [[r:HEB.7.2|Heb 7:2]]; ὅπλα δ., [[r:ROM.6.13|Rom 6:13]]; ὁδὸς δ., [[r:MAT.21.32|Mat 21:32]]; θώραξ τῆς δ., [[r:EPH.6.14|Eph 6:14]]; διὰκονοι δ., [[r:2CO.11.15|2Co 11:15]]; ὁσιότης καὶ δ., [[r:LUK.1.75|Luk 1:75]], cf. [[r:EPH.4.24|Eph 4:24]]; ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δ., [[r:EPH.5.9|Eph 5:9]]; δ. κ. εἰρήνη κ. χαρά, [[r:ROM.14.17|Rom 14:17]]; δ. κ. ἁγιασμός, [[r:1CO.1.30|1Co 1:30]]; opposite to ἁμαρτία, [[r:ROM.8.10|Rom 8:10]]; ἀνομία, [[r:2CO.6.14|2Co 6:14]]; άδικία, [[r:ROM.3.5|Rom 3:5]]; ποιεῖν τὴν δ., [[r:1JN.2.29|1Jn 2:29]] [[r:JHN.3.7|Jn 3:7]]; id. as an inclusive term for the active duties of the religious life (ICC, in l; Abbott, Essays, 73 ff), [[r:MAT.6.1|Mat 6:1]]; ἐργάζεσθαι δ., [[r:ACT.10.35|Act 10:35]]; διώκειν δ., [[r:1TI.6.11|1Ti 6:11]]; πληροῦν πᾶσαν δ., [[r:MAT.3.15|Mat 3:15]]; ζῆν τῇ δ., [[r:1PE.2.24|1Pe 2:24]]; δ. θεοῦ, a righteousness divine in its character and origin, [[r:MAT.6.33|Mat 6:33]], [[r:JAS.1.20|Jas 1:20]], (where it also includes the idea of God's personal r.; see ICC, on [[r:ROM.1.17|Rom 1:17]]) [[r:ROM.1.17|Rom 1:17 3:5, 21-26 10:3]], [[r:2CO.5.21|2Co 5:21]], [[r:PHP.3.9|Php 3:9]]; ἡ δ. τ. πίσιεως, [[r:ROM.4.11|Rom 4:11]]; ἡ ἐκ π. δ., [[r:ROM.9.30|Rom 9:30]]; ἡ κατὰ π. δ., [[r:HEB.11.7|Heb 11:7]]; opposite to this is ἡ ἐκ νόμου δ., [[r:ROM.10.5|Rom 10:5]]; ἡ δ. ἐν ν., [[r:PHP.3.6|Php 3:6]]; ἡ ἰδία δ., [[r:ROM.10.3|Rom 10:3]], cf. [[r:PHP.3.9|Php 3:9]]
In narrower sense (cf. δίκαιος), justice: [[r:ACT.17.31|Act 17:31]], [[r:2PE.1.1|2Pe 1:1]], [[r:REV.19.11|Rev 19:11]] (DCG, ii, 529 ff.; Cremer, 190, 690). (AS)

G1391.strongs: glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective)
senses: opinion, estimation in which one is held, repute; in NT, always good opinion, hence reputation, praise, honour, glory: [[r:LUK.14.10|Luk 14:10]], [[r:JHN.12.43|Jhn 12:43]], [[r:HEB.3.3|Heb 3:3]]; opposite to αἰσχύνη, [[r:PHP.3.19|Php 3:19]]; to ἀτιμία, [[r:2CO.6.8|2Co 6:8]]; δ. κ. τιμή, [[r:ROM.2.7|Rom 2:7, 10]] [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7]], [[r:2PE.1.17|2Pe 1:17]]; ζητεῖν, [[r:JHN.5.44|Jhn 5:44 7:18 8:50]], [[r:1TH.2.6|1Th 2:6]]; λαμβάνειν, [[r:JHN.5.41|Jhn 5:41]], [[r:2PE.1.17|2Pe 1:17]], [[r:REV.5.12|Rev 5:12]]; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, [[r:JER.13.16|Jer 13:16]], al.), [[r:LUK.17.18|Luk 17:18]], [[r:JHN.9.24|Jhn 9:24]], [[r:ACT.12.23|Act 12:23]], [[r:ROM.4.20|Rom 4:20]], [[r:REV.4.9|Rev 4:9]]; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.3.7|Rom 3:7 15:7]], [[r:PHP.1.11|Php 1:11]], al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ., [[r:LUK.2.14|Luk 2:14]], [[r:ROM.11.36|Rom 11:36 16:27]], [[r:GAL.1.5|Gal 1:5]], [[r:EPH.3.21|Eph 3:21]], al.

Later also (not cl.) as in LXX (= הוֹד, [[r:JOB.39.20|Job 39:20]], [[r:1CH.29.25|1Ch 29:25]]; כָּבוֹד, [[r:JOB.19.9|Job 19:9]], [[r:EST.5.11|Est 5:11]], al.), visible brightness, splendour, glory: of light, [[r:ACT.22.11|Act 22:11]]; of heavenly bodies, [[r:1CO.15.40|1Co 15:40]]ff.; esp. that wh. radiates from God's presence, as manifested in the pillar of cloud and in the Holy of Holies (= כָּבוֹד, [[r:EXO.16.10|Exo 16:10 25:22 40:34]], al.; and new Heb. שְׁכִינָה, [[r:2MA.2.8|2Ma 2:8]]; see DB, iv, 489b), [[r:ROM.9.4|Rom 9:4]], [[r:JAS.2.1|Jas 2:1]] (see Hort, Mayor, in l.); hence of the manifested glory of God, [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]], [[r:COL.1.11|Col 1:11]] [[r:EPH.1.6|Eph 1:6, 12 17 3:16]]; of the same as communicated to man through Christ, [[r:2CO.3.18|2Co 3:18 4:6]]; and of the glorious condition into which Christians shall enter hereafter, [[r:ROM.8.18|Rom 8:18, 21 9:23]], [[r:2TI.2.10|2Ti 2:10]], al. SYN.: ἔπαινος τιμή (see Hort on [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7]]). (AS)

G1325.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses)
G1325.strongs: to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection)
G1325.kjv: adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield
senses: to give—in various senses, accusative to context—bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield: absol., [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]]; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.9|Mat 4:9 5:31]], [[r:JHN.1.12|Jhn 1:12]], al. mult.; with dative of person(s), before ἐκ, [[r:MAT.25.8|Mat 25:8]]; id. with genitive part.. [[r:REV.2.17|Rev 2:17]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.3.16|Jhn 3:16]], [[r:REV.20.13|Rev 20:13]], al.; δεξιάς, [[r:GAL.2.9|Gal 2:9]]; φίλημα, [[r:LUK.7.45|Luk 7:45]]; γνῶσιν, [[r:LUK.1.77|Luk 1:77]]; κρίσιν, [[r:JHN.5.22|Jhn 5:22]]; of seed yielding fruit, [[r:MRK.4.7|Mrk 4:7]], 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., LAE, 117f.), [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58]]; with inf. fin., [[r:MAT.27.34|Mat 27:34]], [[r:MRK.5.43|Mrk 5:43]], [[r:LUK.8.55|Luk 8:55]], [[r:JHN.6.52|Jhn 6:52]], al.; with dative of person(s) and inf., [[r:LUK.1.74|Luk 1:74]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.2.27|Act 2:27]], [[r:REV.3.9|Rev 3:9]]; with dupl. accusative, [[r:MAT.20.28|Mat 20:28]], [[r:MRK.10.45|Mrk 10:45]], [[r:EPH.1.22|Eph 1:22 4:11]], [[r:2TH.3.9|2Th 3:9]], [[r:1TI.2.6|1Ti 2:6]], al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), [[r:ACT.19.31|Act 19:31]]; with dative of person(s), before κατά (MM, Exp., xi), [[r:REV.2.28|Rev 2:28]] (LXX); δ. ἵνα, [[r:REV.3.9|Rev 3:9]]; δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, [[r:REV.3.8|Rev 3:8.]] SYN.: δωρέομαι. (AS)

G1350.root: probably from a primary verb δίκω (to cast)
senses: general term for a net: [[r:MAT.4.20|Mat 4:20-21]], [[r:MRK.1.18|Mrk 1:18-19]], [[r:LUK.5.2|Luk 5:2, 4-6]], [[r:JHN.21.6|Jhn 21:6, 8 21:11]] † SYN.: ἀμφίβληστρον (which see), σαγήνη. (AS)

G1321.root: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb δάω (to learn)
G1321.strongs: to teach (in the same broad application)
senses: trans.: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.2|Mat 5:2]], [[r:MRK.1.22|Mrk 1:22]], al.; before ὅτι, [[r:MRK.8.31|Mrk 8:31]]; περί, [[r:1JN.2.27|1Jn 2:27]]; with inf., [[r:LUK.11.1|Luk 11:1]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.6.30|Mrk 6:30 12:14]]; with cogn. accusative, [[r:MAT.15.9|Mat 15:9]] (LXX); with dupl. accusative, [[r:MRK.4.2|Mrk 4:2]], [[r:JHN.14.26|Jhn 14:26]]; pass., [[r:GAL.1.12|Gal 1:12]], [[r:2TH.2.15|2Th 2:15]]; with dative of person(s) (like Heb., cf. [[r:JOB.21.23|Job 21:23]], but prob. a vernac. usage, see Swete, in l.), [[r:REV.2.14|Rev 2:14.]]

Absol., to teach, give instruction: [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]], [[r:MRK.1.21|Mrk 1:21]], and often in Gosp., [[r:ROM.12.7|Rom 12:7]], [[r:1CO.4.17|1Co 4:17]], [[r:1TI.2.12|1Ti 2:12]], al. SYN.: παιδεύω (cf. Westc., Heb., 402; Cremer, 180). (AS)

διψάω,-ῶ (δίψα, thirst), to thirst: absol., [[r:MAT.25.35|Mat 25:35, 37 25:42, 44]], [[r:JHN.4.13|Jhn 4:13, 15 19:28]], [[r:ROM.12.20|Rom 12:20]]" (LXX), [[r:1CO.4.11|1Co 4:11]]; figuratively, [[r:JHN.4.14|Jhn 4:14 6:35 7:37]], [[r:REV.7.16|Rev 7:16 21:6 22:17]]; with accusative (= cl. with genitive), τ. δικαιοσύνην, [[r:MAT.5.6|Mat 5:6.]]† (AS)

G1377.root: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb δίω (to flee
G1377.strongs: compare the base of and); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute
G1377.kjv: ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward
senses: metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), of seeking eagerly after: [[r:ROM.9.30|Rom 9:30]], [[r:1TI.6.11|1Ti 6:11]], [[r:2TI.2.22|2Ti 2:22]]; νόμον δικαιοσύνης, [[r:ROM.9.31|Rom 9:31]]; τ. φιλοξενίαν, [[r:ROM.12.13|Rom 12:13]]; εἰρήνην, [[r:HEB.12.14|Heb 12:14]], [[r:1PE.3.11|1Pe 3:11]]; τὰ τῆς εἰ., [[r:ROM.14.19|Rom 14:19]]; τ. ἀγάπην, [[r:1CO.14.1|1Co 14:1]]; τὸ ἀγαθόν, [[r:1TH.5.15|1Th 5:15]]; absol., to follow on, drive, or speed on (Æsch.), [[r:PHP.3.12|Php 3:12, 14]].† (AS)

G1392.strongs: to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application)
G1392.kjv: (make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify
senses: to think, suppose, hold an opinion (Æsch., Plat., al.).

To bestow δόξα (which see) on, to magnify, extol, praise (Thuc., iii, 45; Plut., al.): with accusative, [[r:MAT.5.16|Mat 5:16]], [[r:MRK.2.12|Mrk 2:12]], [[r:JHN.8.54|Jhn 8:54]], [[r:ROM.15.6|Rom 15:6]], [[r:1PE.2.12|1Pe 2:12]], al.; id. before ἐπί [[r:LUK.2.20|Luk 2:20]]; ἐν, [[r:GAL.1.24|Gal 1:24]], [[r:1PE.4.16|1Pe 4:16]].

In LXX and NT (see: δόξα, 3), to clothe with splendour, glorify ([[r:EXO.34.29|Exo 34:29-30]], [[r:PSA.37.20|Psa 37:20]], [[r:ISA.44.23|Isa 44:23]], [[r:EST.3.1|Est 3:1]], al): [[r:ROM.8.30|Rom 8:30]], [[r:2CO.3.10|2Co 3:10]], [[r:2TH.3.1|2Th 3:1]], [[r:1PE.1.8|1Pe 1:8]], al.; of Christ, [[r:JHN.7.39|Jhn 7:39 8:54]], al. (on the Johannine use, see Cremer, 211; Westc., Jo., Intr.); of the Father, [[r:JHN.13.31|Jhn 13:31-32]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]], al. (cf. ἐν-, συν-δοξάζω). (AS)
δι-ορύσσω to dig through: with accusative, of house-breaking (as in π.; MM, Exp., xi), [[r:MAT.24.43|Mat 24:43]], [[r:LUK.12.39|Luk 12:39]]; absol., [[r:MAT.6.19|Mat 6:19-20.]]† (AS)

G1398.strongs: to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary)
senses: (δοῦλος), to be a slave, be subject to, serve: absol., [[r:ROM.7.6|Rom 7:6]], [[r:GAL.4.25|Gal 4:25]], [[r:1TI.6.2|1Ti 6:2]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.6.24|Mat 6:24]], [[r:LUK.15.29|Luk 15:29 16:13]], [[r:ROM.9.12|Rom 9:12]]" (LXX); of nations, [[r:JHN.8.33|Jhn 8:33]], [[r:ACT.7.7|Act 7:7]]" (LXX); θεῷ, τ. κυρίῳ, [[r:MAT.6.24|Mat 6:24]], [[r:LUK.16.13|Luk 16:13]], [[r:ACT.20.19|Act 20:19]], [[r:ROM.12.11|Rom 12:11]] (R, mg., καιρῷ) [[r:ROM.16.18|Rom 16:18]], [[r:EPH.6.7|Eph 6:7]], [[r:COL.3.24|Col 3:24]], [[r:1TH.1.9|1Th 1:9]]; τ. Χριστῷ, [[r:ROM.14.18|Rom 14:18]], [[r:COL.3.24|Col 3:24]]; νόμῳ θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.7.25|Rom 7:25]]; τ. θεοῖς, [[r:GAL.4.8|Gal 4:8]]; τ. καιρῷ, [[r:ROM.12.11|Rom 12:11]] (R, mg. for κυρίῳ); ἀλλήλοις, [[r:GAL.5.13|Gal 5:13]]; σὺν ἐμοί [[r:PHP.2.22|Php 2:22]]; τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]]; νόμῳ ἁμαρτίας, [[r:ROM.7.25|Rom 7:25]]; ἐπιθυμίαις κ. ἡδοναις, [[r:TIT.3.3|Tit 3:3]]; τ. κοιλία, [[r:ROM.16.18|Rom 16:18]]; μαμωνᾷ, [[r:MAT.6.24|Mat 6:24]], [[r:LUK.16.13|Luk 16:13]]; τ. στοιχείοις τ, κόσμου, [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]] (Cremer, 217).† (AS)

G1308.strongs: to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass
G1308.kjv: be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value
senses: to differ: τὰ διαφέροντα, [[r:ROM.2.18|Rom 2:18]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]] (R, mg., but see infr.); impers., διαφέρει, it makes a difference, it matters: [[r:GAL.2.6|Gal 2:6]];

to excel: with genitive [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26 10:31 12:12]], [[r:LUK.12.7|Luk 12:7, 24]], [[r:1CO.15.41|1Co 15:41]], [[r:GAL.4.1|Gal 4:1]]; τὰ διαφέροντα, [[r:ROM.2.18|Rom 2:18]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]] (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. see ICC on Ro, Phi, ll. with).† (AS)

G1385.root: from [[w:G1209]] (through the idea of holding up)

senses: objectively, teaching, doctrine, that which is taught: [[r:MRK.1.27|Mrk 1:27]], [[r:JHN.7.16|Jhn 7:16]], [[r:ACT.17.19|Act 17:19]], [[r:ROM.6.7|Rom 6:7 16:17]], 2Jn 10, [[r:REV.2.24|Rev 2:24]]; with genitive poss., [[r:MAT.7.28|Mat 7:28 16:12 22:33]], [[r:MRK.1.22|Mrk 1:22 11:18]], [[r:LUK.4.32|Luk 4:32]], [[r:JHN.18.19|Jhn 18:19]], [[r:ACT.5.28|Act 5:28]], [[r:REV.2.14|Rev 2:14-15]]; ἡ δ., of Christ, [[r:JHN.7.17|Jhn 7:17]], [[r:ACT.13.12|Act 13:12]], 2Jn 9; of. τὴν δ., [[r:TIT.1.9|Tit 1:9]]; with genitive obj., βαπτισμῶν δ., [[r:HEB.6.2|Heb 6:2]]; pl., [[r:HEB.13.9|Heb 13:9.]]

Actively, teaching: [[r:ACT.2.42|Act 2:42]], [[r:2TI.4.2|2Ti 4:2]]; ἐν τ. δ., in the course of his teaching: [[r:MRK.4.2|Mrk 4:2 12:38]]; λαλεῖν ἐν δ., [[r:1CO.14.6|1Co 14:6]]; ἔχειν δ., [[r:1CO.14.26|1Co 14:26]] (DCG, i, 485; Cremer, 181).† SYN.: διδασκαλία (AS)

(διδάσκω), given as rendering of Heb. רַבִּי,רַבּוֺן (NT, Ῥαββεί, Ῥαββουνεί which see); a teacher: [[r:JHN.1.39|Jhn 1:39 20:16]]; of Jewish teachers, [[r:LUK.2.46|Luk 2:46]], [[r:JHN.3.10|Jhn 3:10]], cf. [[r:ROM.2.20|Rom 2:20-21]]; of John Baptist, [[r:LUK.3.12|Luk 3:12]]; of Jesus, [[r:JHN.3.2|Jhn 3:2, 10 8:4 11:28 13:13-14]], and often in Syn., most frequently in voc., as title of address, as [[r:MAT.8.19|Mat 8:19]], [[r:MRK.4.38|Mrk 4:38]]; of Jesus by himself, [[r:MAT.23.8|Mat 23:8]]; of an apostle, [[r:1TI.2.7|1Ti 2:7]], [[r:2TI.1.11|2Ti 1:11]]; of Christians, [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28-29]], [[r:EPH.4.11|Eph 4:11]], [[r:ACT.13.1|Act 13:1]], [[r:JAS.3.1|Jas 3:1]]; of false teachers, [[r:2TI.4.3|2Ti 4:3]] (Cremer, 181; DB, i, 609, iii, 294, iv, 691) SYN.: παιδευτής, q.v (AS)

G1310.kjv: blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame
senses: δια-φημίζω in late writers only, to spread abroad: τ. λόγον (= דָּבָר, the matter), [[r:MRK.1.45|Mrk 1:45]], [[r:MAT.28.15|Mat 28:15]]; with accusative of person(s), to spread abroad one's fame: [[r:MAT.9.31|Mat 9:31.]]† (AS)

G1369.strongs: to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate)
senses: (δίχα, apart), to cut apart, divide in two; metaphorically, to set at variance: [[r:MAT.10.35|Mat 10:35.]]† (AS)

G1344.strongs: to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent
senses: with accusative of thing(s), to deem right;
with accusative of person(s), to do one justice; pass., δικαιοῦσθαι, to be treated rightly, opposite to ἀδικεῖσθαι.

In NT, as in LXX, and as usual with verbs in -όω from adjectives of moral meaning; (1) to show to be righteous: [[r:MAT.11.19|Mat 11:19]], [[r:LUK.7.35|Luk 7:35]], [[r:ROM.3.4|Rom 3:4]]" (LXX), [[r:1TI.3.16|1Ti 3:16]]; (2) to declare, pronounce righteous: [[r:LUK.7.29|Luk 7:29 10:29 16:15 18:14]], [[r:ROM.2.13|Rom 2:13 3:24, 26 3:28 4:5 8:30, 33]], [[r:TIT.3.7|Tit 3:7]]; before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.11.19|Mat 11:19]], [[r:LUK.7.35|Luk 7:35]], [[r:ACT.13.39|Act 13:39]], [[r:ROM.6.7|Rom 6:7]]; ἐκ πίστεως, [[r:ROM.3.30|Rom 3:30 5:1]], [[r:GAL.2.16|Gal 2:16 3:8, 24]]; ἐξ ἔργων, [[r:ROM.3.20|Rom 3:20]] (LXX) [[r:ROM.4.2|Rom 4:2]], [[r:GAL.2.16|Gal 2:16]], [[r:JAS.2.21|Jas 2:21, 24-25]]; ἐκ τ. λόγων, [[r:MAT.12.37|Mat 12:37]]; διὰ τ. πίστεως, [[r:ROM.3.30|Rom 3:30]]; with dative, [[r:ROM.3.24|Rom 3:24, 28]], [[r:TIT.3.7|Tit 3:7]]; before ἐν, [[r:ACT.13.39|Act 13:39]], [[r:ROM.3.4|Rom 3:4 5:9]], [[r:1CO.4.4|1Co 4:4 6:11]], [[r:GAL.2.17|Gal 2:17 3:11 5:4]], [[r:1TI.3.16|1Ti 3:16]] (see Cremer, 193, 693; DB, ii, 826 ff.).† (AS)

G1330.kjv: come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through
senses: of persons: [[r:LUK.19.4|Luk 19:4]]; with accusative loc., [[r:LUK.19.1|Luk 19:1]], [[r:HEB.4.14|Heb 4:14]], [[r:ACT.12.10|Act 12:10]]; before διά, with genitive loc., [[r:MAT.12.43|Mat 12:43]], [[r:1CO.10.1|1Co 10:1]]; before εἰς, [[r:MRK.4.35|Mrk 4:35]]; ἕως, [[r:LUK.2.15|Luk 2:15.]]
to go about: [[r:LUK.9.6|Luk 9:6]], [[r:ACT.20.25|Act 20:25]]; of a report, to spread, go abroad (Thuc.), [[r:LUK.5.15|Luk 5:15]] (AS)

G1365.strongs: properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion)
senses: (δίς), to doubt, hesitate: [[r:MAT.14.31|Mat 14:31 28:17]].† SYN.: ἀπορέω, διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)

(διδάσκω), teaching, instruction, in both active and objective senses, most frequently the latter: [[r:ROM.12.7|Rom 12:7 15:4]], [[r:EPH.4.14|Eph 4:14]], [[r:1TI.4.6|1Ti 4:6, 13, 16 5:17 6:1, 3]], [[r:2TI.3.10|2Ti 3:10 3:16]], [[r:TIT.2.7|Tit 2:7, 10]]; ὑγιαινοῦσα δ., [[r:1TI.1.10|1Ti 1:10]], [[r:2TI.4.3|2Ti 4:3]], [[r:TIT.1.9|Tit 1:9 2:1]]; pl., δ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[r:COL.2.22|Col 2:22]]; δ. δαιμονίων, [[r:1TI.4.1|1Ti 4:1]], δ. διδάσκειν, [[r:MAT.15.9|Mat 15:9]], [[r:MRK.7.7|Mrk 7:7]]" (LXX) (Cremer, 182).† SYN.: διδαχή (AS)
(δίς, δραχμή), worth two drachmae; τὸ δ. (sc. νόμισμα, coin), a double drachma, nearly equal to the Jewish half-shekel, the amount of the Temple tax: [[r:MAT.17.24|Mat 17:24]] (DB, iii, 428).† (AS)

G1327.strongs: an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge)
senses: δι-έ-οδος, -ου, ἡ in π. of the conclusion of a trial (MM, Exp., xi); a way out through, an outlet; pl., δ. τῶν ὁδῶν, RV, the partings of the highways: [[r:MAT.22.9|Mat 22:9.]]† (AS)

διπλόος (poët., διπλός, whence corp. -ότερον), -όη, -όον (-οῦ, -ῆ, -οῦν) twofold, double: [[r:1TI.5.17|1Ti 5:17]], [[r:REV.18.6|Rev 18:6]]; διπλότιρον, in twofold measure: [[r:MAT.23.15|Mat 23:15.]]† (AS)

G1371.root: from a compound of a derivative of [[w:G1364]] and a derivative of τέμνω (to cut)
G1371.strongs: to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely
senses: (διχοτόμος, δίχα, τέμνω), to cut in two, cut asunder: perh. metaphorically of severe scourging (but see Meyer on Mt, l.with, and cf. [[r:1KI.15.33|1Ki 15:33]], [[r:2SA.12.31|2Ki 12:31]], [[r:HEB.11.37|Heb 11:37]]), [[r:MAT.24.51|Mat 24:51]], [[r:LUK.12.46|Luk 12:46]].† (AS)

G1388.root: from an obsolete primary verb, δέλλω (probably meaning to decoy

G1326.strongs: to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively)
senses: δι-εγείρω to arouse completely, arouse as from rest or sleep: [[r:LUK.8.24|Luk 8:24]]; pass., [[r:MRK.4.39|Mrk 4:39]], [[r:LUK.8.24|Luk 8:24]]; of the sea, [[r:JHN.6.18|Jhn 6:18.]] Metaphorical, of the mind: ἐν ὑπομνήσει, [[r:2PE.1.13|2Pe 1:13 3:1]].† (AS)
two thousand , (Herdotus Historicus):—;singular with collective nouns, δισχιλίη ἵππος 2000 horse, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι to set out in detail, recount, describe: absol., [[r:HEB.11.32|Heb 11:32]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.8.33|Act 8:33]]; with dative of person(s), before πῶς, [[r:MRK.5.16|Mrk 5:16]], [[r:ACT.9.27|Act 9:27 12:17]]; ἅ εἶδον, [[r:MRK.9.9|Mrk 9:9]]; ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, [[r:LUK.8.39|Luk 8:39 9:10]].† (AS)

δίς adv., twice: [[r:MRK.14.30|Mrk 14:30, 72]]; δ. τ. σαββάτου, [[r:LUK.18.12|Luk 18:12]]; καὶ ἅπαξ κ. δ., [[r:PHP.4.16|Php 4:16]], [[r:1TH.2.18|1Th 2:18]]; δ. ἀποθανόντα, Ju 12 (see Mayor, ICC, in l); δ. μυριάδες, [[r:REV.9.16|Rev 9:16.]]† (AS)

G1345.strongs: an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision
senses: (δικαιόω), a concrete expression of righteousness, the expression and result of the act of δικαίωσις, "a declaration that a thing is δίκαιον, or that a person is δίκαιος," hence,
an ordinance: δ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.1.32|Rom 1:32]]; τ. κυρίου, [[r:LUK.1.6|Luk 1:6]]; τ. νόμου, [[r:ROM.2.26|Rom 2:26 8:4]]; λατρείας, [[r:HEB.9.1|Heb 9:1]]; σαρκός, [[r:HEB.9.10|Heb 9:10]];

a sentence: of acquittal, [[r:ROM.5.16|Rom 5:16]] (also [[r:ROM.5.18|Rom 5:18]]; ICC, in l), or of condemnation; (with) a righteous act: [[r:ROM.5.18|Rom 5:18]] (RV), [[r:REV.15.4|Rev 15:4 19:8]] (on the usage of π., see MM, Exp., iii, xi). † (AS)

G1360.strongs: on the very account that, or inasmuch as
senses: δι-ότι , conjunct., for διὰ τοῦτο, ὅτι (Lat. propterea quod), because: [[r:LUK.1.13|Luk 1:13 2:7 21:28]], [[r:ACT.13.35|Act 13:35 18:10 20:26 22:18]], [[r:ROM.1.19|Rom 1:19, 21 3:20 8:7, 21]], [[r:1CO.15.9|1Co 15:9]], [[r:PHP.2.26|Php 2:26]], [[r:1TH.2.8|1Th 2:8, 18]] (Lft., Notes, 37) [[r:1TH.4.6|1Th 4:6]], [[r:HEB.11.5|Heb 11:5, 23]], [[r:JAS.4.3|Jas 4:3]], [[r:1PE.1.16|1Pe 1:16 1:24 2:6]]. It is usually stronger than ὅτι, but sometimes, as in [[r:LUK.1.13|Luk 1:13]], [[r:ROM.1.19|Rom 1:19]], [[r:1TH.2.18|1Th 2:18]], approximates to MGr. sense, for; cf. Milligan, Th., l.with† (AS)
As subst., ὁ, ἡ δ., a slave;
fem., ἡ δ., a female slave, bondmaid (Cremer, 702; DB, iii, 215): [[r:LUK.1.38|Luk 1:38, 48]] [[r:ACT.2.18|Act 2:18]]" (LXX);

A public decree, ordinance: of Roman rulers, [[r:LUK.2.1|Luk 2:1]], [[r:ACT.17.7|Act 17:7]]; of the Jewish law, [[r:EPH.2.15|Eph 2:15]], [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14]]; of the Apostles, [[r:ACT.16.4|Act 16:4]] (Cremer, 205).† (AS)

G1301.strongs: to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly

G1316.root: from [[w:G1223]] and the middle voice of [[w:G5563]]
senses: δια-χωρίζω to separate entirely. Mid., to separate oneself, depart: before ἀπό [[r:LUK.9.33|Luk 9:33.]]† (AS)

G1311.strongs: to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert)
senses: to destroy utterly: [[r:LUK.12.33|Luk 12:33]], [[r:REV.11.18|Rev 11:18]]; pass., to be destroyed, disabled: [[r:REV.8.9|Rev 8:9]], [[r:2CO.4.16|2Co 4:16]].
In moral sense, to corrupt, deprave: τ. γῆν, [[r:REV.11.18|Rev 11:18]]; pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν, [[r:1TI.6.5|1Ti 6:5.]]† (AS)

G1381.strongs: to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve
G1381.kjv: allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try
senses: primarily of metals ([[r:PRO.8.10|Pro 8:10 17:3]], [[r:SIR.2.5|Sir 2:5]], [[r:WIS.3.6|Wis 3:6]]), to test, try, prove (in the hope and expectation that the test will prove successful, see reff. s. Syn.): χρυσίον, [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7]]; other things, [[r:LUK.12.56|Luk 12:56 14:19]], [[r:2CO.8.8|2Co 8:8]], [[r:GAL.6.4|Gal 6:4]], [[r:1TH.2.4|1Th 2:4 5:21]]; τὰ διαφέροντα, [[r:ROM.2.18|Rom 2:18]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]] (R, mg., but see infr.); πνεύματα, [[r:1JN.4.1|1Jn 4:1]]; of men, [[r:1TI.3.10|1Ti 3:10]] (pass.); ἑαυτόν, [[r:1CO.11.28|1Co 11:28]], [[r:2CO.13.5|2Co 13:5]]; before subst. clause, [[r:ROM.12.2|Rom 12:2]], [[r:1CO.3.13|1Co 3:13]], [[r:EPH.5.10|Eph 5:10]]

As the result of trial, to approve, think fit: [[r:ROM.1.28|Rom 1:28 14:22]], [[r:1CO.16.3|1Co 16:3]], [[r:2CO.8.22|2Co 8:22]], [[r:1TH.2.4|1Th 2:4]] (δεδοκιμάσμεθα); τὰ διαφέροντα, [[r:ROM.2.18|Rom 2:18]], [[r:PHP.1.10|Php 1:10]], R, txt. (but see supr.; cf. διαφέρω).† (AS)

G1303.strongs: to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest)
senses: δια-τίθημι to place separately, arrange, dispose. Mid, only in NT;
(a) in general, to dispose of; with dative of person(s), to assign to one, [[r:LUK.22.29|Luk 22:29]];
to dispose of by a will, make a testament (in cl., δ. διαθήκην also in this sense): [[r:HEB.9.16|Heb 9:16-17]] (but cf. R, mg., and see: διαθήκη).

δ. διαθήκην, to make a covenant (Aristoph.): with dative of person(s), [[r:HEB.8.10|Heb 8:10]] (LXX); before πρ, with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.3.25|Act 3:25]], [[r:HEB.10.16|Heb 10:16]]" (LXX) (cf. ἀντι-διατίθημι).† (AS)

G1339.strongs: to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene
G1339.kjv: go further, be parted, after the space of
senses: δι-ίσπημι (Rec. διΐσ), to set apart, separate; of time (or space), to make an interval, intervene: διαστάσης ὥρας μιᾶς, [[r:LUK.22.59|Luk 22:59]]; βραχὺ διαστήσαντες, [[r:ACT.27.28|Act 27:28.]] In pass., mid. and 2 aor., pf. and plpf. act., to part, withdraw: [[r:LUK.24.51|Luk 24:51.]]† (AS)

G1340.strongs: to stout it through, i.e. asservate
senses: to affirm confidently: with ptcp., [[r:LUK.22.59|Luk 22:59]]; with accusative and inf. (Bl., § 70, 3), [[r:ACT.12.15|Act 12:15.]]† (AS)

G1329.strongs: to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate

senses: δια-τρίβω to rub hard, rub away, consume; δ. χρόνον, ἡμέρας, to spend time: [[r:ACT.14.3|Act 14:3, 28 16:12 20:6 25:6, 14]]. Intransitively with ellipse of object (El., § 81, 1), to spend time, stay: [[r:JHN.3.22|Jhn 3:22 11:54]], [[r:ACT.15.35|Act 15:35]], [[r:ACT.12.19|Act 12:19]].† (AS)
taught; with genitive, of source of teaching (in cl., poët. only);

G1324.strongs: double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian
senses: (prop. name from δίδυμος, -η, -ον, double, sc. παῖς, twin) Didymus, surname of the apostle Thomas: [[r:JHN.11.16|Jhn 11:16 20:24 21:2]].† (AS)

G1315.strongs: to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon
senses: δια-χειρίζω (χείρ), to have in hand, conduct, manage. Mid.
in late writers (Polyb., FlJ, al.), to lay hands on, kill: with accusative, [[r:ACT.5.30|Act 5:30 26:21]].† (AS)

(δικάζω), a judge: [[r:ACT.7.27|Act 7:27, 35]]" (LXX).† SYN.: κριτής, WH. "gives prominence to the mental process" (Thayer). δ. is the forensic term. In Attic law, the δικασταί were jurors, with a κριτής as presiding officer (LS, see word; Enc. Brit. 11, xii, 504 f.) (AS)
(δορκάς, a gazelle), Dorcas, also called Ταβειθά, which see: [[r:ACT.9.36|Act 9:36, 39]].† (AS)

G1331.strongs: to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation

G1356.root: from the alternate of [[w:G2203]] and the alternate of [[w:G4098]]
senses: (δῖος, πίπτω, see Page on Ac, l.with; DB, i, 605, n., ext., 112a; Field, Notes, 130 f.), fallen from heaven (R, mg.): τὸ δ. (sc. ἄγαλμα, statue, image), [[r:ACT.19.35|Act 19:35.]]† (AS)

G1357.root: from a compound of [[w:G1223]] and a derivative of [[w:G3717]], meaning to straighten thoroughly
senses: a reforming, reformation (used in late writers of laws, etc.): [[r:HEB.9.10|Heb 9:10]] (Cremer, 807).† διόρθωμα, -τος, τό (διορθόω, to make straight, set right), a correction, reform: [[r:ACT.24.3|Act 24:3.]]† διόρθωσις, -εως, ἡ (see supr.),
a reforming, reformation (used in late writers of laws, etc.): [[r:HEB.9.10|Heb 9:10]] (Cremer, 807).† (AS)

G1300.strongs: to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist
senses: δια-τελέω, -ῶ prop. trans., to accomplish; used with ellipse of obj. as intrans. (Bl., § 81, 1), and joined to participles (in Ac, Lc., to adj.; see Bl., § 73, 4) with adverbial sense (= continuously), to continue: [[r:ACT.27.33|Act 27:33.]]† (AS)

G1337.strongs: having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet
senses: divided into two seas (as the Euxine, Strab., ii, 522).
dividing the sea: τόπον δ., a tongue of land, or reef, running out into the sea: [[r:ACT.27.41|Act 27:41.]]† (AS)

G1349.strongs: right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution)
senses: a judicial hearing; hence its result, the execution of a sentence, punishment: δ. τίνειν, [[r:2TH.1.9|2Th 1:9]]; δ. υπεχειν, Ju 7.

G1359.root: from the alternate of [[w:G2203]] and a form of the base of [[w:G2877]]
G1359.strongs: sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri
senses: Διόσ-κουροι, -ων, οἱ (Ion. and κοινή form of Att..., Διόσκοροι; Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + κόρος, a son), the Dioscuri (Castor and Pollux), twin sons of Zeus and Leda (RV, The Twin Brothers): [[r:ACT.28.11|Act 28:11.]]† (AS)
righteous judgment: [[r:ROM.2.5|Rom 2:5]] (cf. τ. δικαίας κρίσεως, [[r:2TH.1.5|2Th 1:5]]; τὴν δ. κ., [[r:JHN.7.24|Jhn 7:24.]] For use in π., see Deiss., LAE, 89 f.).† (AS)
(δόλιος), to deceive: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), [[r:ROM.3.13|Rom 3:13]] (LXX).† (AS)
(δικαιόω), the act of pronouncing righteous, justification, acquittal: [[r:ROM.4.25|Rom 4:25 5:18]] (Cremer, 199).† (AS)

G1382.strongs: test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness
senses: The result of trial, approval, approvedness, proof: [[r:ROM.5.4|Rom 5:4]], [[r:2CO.2.9|2Co 2:9 13:3]], [[r:PHP.2.22|Php 2:22]] (Cremer, 212, 701).† (AS)

G1384.strongs: properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved
senses: δοκίμιος, -α, -ον (δοκιμή), = δόκιμος, tested, approved: τὸ δ. ὑμῶν τ. πίστεως, that which is approved in your faith, [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7]] (where Hort suggests the seel. δόκιμος, found in some cursives), [[r:JAS.1.3|Jas 1:3]] (but see Mayor, in l For full discussion of this word, not hitherto found in a Gk. Lexicon, and for exx. of its use in π., see Deiss. (to whom is due the credit of its discovery), BS, 259 ff.; MM, Exp., xi; cf. also Milligan, NTD, 76).† δόκιμος, -ον (δέκομαι = δέχομαι) primarily of metals, tested, accepted, approved: of persons, [[r:ROM.14.18|Rom 14:18 16:10]], [[r:1CO.11.19|1Co 11:19]], [[r:2CO.10.18|2Co 10:18 13:7]], [[r:2TI.2.15|2Ti 2:15]], [[r:JAS.1.12|Jas 1:12]] (Cremer, 212, 697).† (AS)
διό-περ conjunct. (διό, which see, strengthened by πέρ), for which very reason: [[r:1CO.8.13|1Co 8:13 10:14]].† (AS)

G1396.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G1401]] and [[w:G0071]]
G1396.strongs: to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue)
senses: (δοῦλος, ἄγω), to make a slave, bring into bondage: [[r:1CO.9.27|1Co 9:27]] (Cremer, 703).† (AS)
As of wine, to adulterate, corrupt: τ. λόγον τ. θεοῦ, [[r:2CO.4.2|2Co 4:2.]]† SYN.: καπηλεύω which see (AS)

G1394.strongs: a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift

G1379.strongs: to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule
senses: δογματίζω to decree. Mid., to subject oneself to an ordinance: [[r:COL.2.20|Col 2:20.]]† (AS)

G1351.strongs: equivocal, i.e. telling a different story
senses: in sense of διλογεῖν, -ία (Xen.), given to repetition.
of rivers and roads, double-mouthed, double branching.

G1336.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G1223]] and a derivative of an alternate of [[w:G5342]]
G1336.strongs: carried through, i.e. (adverbially with and prefixed) perpetually
senses: δι-ηνεκής, -ές (διήνεγκα, aorist of διαφέρω) unbroken, continuous: adverbially, εἰς τὸ δ., continually (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 251), [[r:HEB.7.3|Heb 7:3 10:1, 12 10:14]]† (AS)

G1383.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G1382]]
senses: usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, a test, and so perh. [[r:JAS.1.3|Jas 1:3]] (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).† (AS)

G1374.strongs: two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose)

G1306.strongs: to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day)
senses: δι-αυγάζω to shine through, to dawn: [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19]] (cf. ἕως οὗ διαπνεύσῃ ἡ ἡμέρα, [[r:GAL.2.17|Gal 2:17]]).† (AS)

G1361.strongs: Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity
senses: Διοτρέφης (Rec. -τρεψής), -ες (Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + τρέφω: cherished by Zeus), as proper name, Diotrephes: III Jn 9.† (AS)
